### Issue URL (Ads) [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/refs/heads/master/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAdguardTeam%2FAdguardFilters%2Frefs%2Fheads%2Fmaster%2FBaseFilter%2Fsections%2Fforeign.txt) ### Comment > Please consider creating the AdGuard Czech and Slovak Filter. > > Problem: > According to the W3C (https://w3techs.com/technologies/overview/content_language), the amount of content on the internet is 1.3% Czech + Slovak (combined). This is more than languages such as Chinese. > > Currently, the number of Czech and Slovak rules in respective section of foreign.txt from Base Filter has already surpassed the number of rules in the existing recommended regional filter list, EasyList Czech and Slovak. > > foreign.txt Czech and Slovak domains: ~1.5k > EasyList Czech and Slovak domains: ~1k > > foreign.txt Czech and Slovak number of rules: 862 > EasyList Czech and Slovak number of rules: 624 > > Therefore, the Czech and Slovak languages are likely large enough to get their AdGuard regional filter lists. > > Solution: > AdGuard already has many Czech and Slovak rules in foreign.txt. Move those rules into their own filter list folder, and merge it with or include EasyList Czech and Slovak as upstream. > > Combining these rules into one unified AdGuard Czech and Slovak filter list will bring the total number of rules to almost 1,500. This will bring much greater coverage for users who browse websites in these languages. > > Thank you for considering my request. ``` Username: @braverug ``` ### Screenshots
